retention_constraints: Selected controller fo self-holds fault history until hr_q reset; capture before source regional reset can erase it. KC fi/f1/f2/kf are forwarding, not independent detector primitives.
KC f_ovf requires source-local sticky capture immune to source reset; kf is unbound in all four actual selected top instances.
No-reset relay startup is unknown until actual clocks have propagated valid source state; never convert historical HOLD128 comment to native readiness proof.
Raw POR/PLL retention implementation and capture under stopped clock remain unimplemented; no quiet window assumed.
